description.purpose: Happy path. Alice has 0 active loans; Hamlet has 2 copies and only 1 is out (to Bob). Both branches of can_borrow hold.
description.notes: Demonstrates Verify reporting unique + Solve producing a clean diff.

c_hard: new Loan created with borrower=alice, book=hamlet, status=active

annotations.uniqueness_argument: Both alice (count=0 < 3) and hamlet (available_copies=1 ≥ 1) pass can_borrow. Exactly 1 model.

description.purpose: Refusal — borrower at loan cap. Bob has 3 active loans; can_borrow fails on the cardinality branch regardless of book availability.

annotations.uniqueness_argument: active_loan_count(bob) = 3, fails the N < 3 condition. can_borrow(bob, _) is false for any book. 0 models = policy refused.

description.purpose: Refusal — book out of stock. Alice could borrow but Ulysses has 1 total copy and Bob has it. can_borrow fails on the availability branch.

annotations.uniqueness_argument: available_copies(ulysses) = 0. has_available_copy(ulysses) is false. can_borrow(alice, ulysses) is false. 0 models = policy refused.
